calendar_event_exceptions_kind_columns_m.name: calendar_event_exceptions_kind_columns_match
calendar_event_exceptions_kind_columns_m.value:
("calendar_event_exceptions"."kind" = 'cancelled' and "calendar_event_exceptions"."title" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."all_day" is null
            and "calendar_event_exceptions"."date" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."starts_at" is null
            and "calendar_event_exceptions"."ends_at" is null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."timezone" is null)
        or ("calendar_event_exceptions"."kind" = 'override' and "calendar_event_exceptions"."title" is not null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."all_day" is not null
            and ("calendar_event_exceptions"."all_day" = ("calendar_event_exceptions"."date" is not null))
            and ("calendar_event_exceptions"."all_day" = ("calendar_event_exceptions"."starts_at" is null))
            and ("calendar_event_exceptions"."all_day" = ("calendar_event_exceptions"."timezone" is null))
            and ("calendar_event_exceptions"."all_day" or ("calendar_event_exceptions"."ends_at" is not null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."starts_at" is not null and "calendar_event_exceptions"."ends_at" > "calendar_event_exceptions"."starts_at")))

calendar_events_all_day_columns_match.name: calendar_events_all_day_columns_match
calendar_events_all_day_columns_match.value:
("calendar_events"."all_day" = ("calendar_events"."date" is not null))
        and ("calendar_events"."all_day" = ("calendar_events"."starts_at" is null))
        and ("calendar_events"."all_day" = ("calendar_events"."timezone" is null))

calendar_events_timed_end_after_start.name: calendar_events_timed_end_after_start
calendar_events_timed_end_after_start.value: "calendar_events"."all_day" or ("calendar_events"."ends_at" is not null and "calendar_events"."starts_at" is not null and "calendar_events"."ends_at" > "calendar_events"."starts_at")

journal_entries_published_at_matches_sta.name: journal_entries_published_at_matches_state
journal_entries_published_at_matches_sta.value:
("journal_entries"."state" = 'published' and "journal_entries"."published_at" is not null)
        or ("journal_entries"."state" = 'draft' and "journal_entries"."published_at" is null)
        or ("journal_entries"."state" = 'trashed'
            and "journal_entries"."trashed_from_state" is not null
            and "journal_entries"."trashed_at" is not null
            and (("journal_entries"."trashed_from_state" = 'published' and "journal_entries"."published_at" is not null)
              or ("journal_entries"."trashed_from_state" = 'draft' and "journal_entries"."published_at" is null)))

journal_entries_trash_columns_match_stat.name: journal_entries_trash_columns_match_state
journal_entries_trash_columns_match_stat.value:
("journal_entries"."state" = 'trashed') = ("journal_entries"."trashed_at" is not null)
        and ("journal_entries"."state" = 'trashed') = ("journal_entries"."trashed_from_state" is not null)

entry_images_size_matches_state.name: entry_images_size_matches_state
entry_images_size_matches_state.value: ("entry_images"."state" = 'ready') = ("entry_images"."width" is not null and "entry_images"."height" is not null)

sync_tombstones_audience_member_consiste.name: sync_tombstones_audience_member_consistent
sync_tombstones_audience_member_consiste.value: ("sync_tombstones"."audience" = 'all' and "sync_tombstones"."member_id" is null) or ("sync_tombstones"."audience" = 'member' and "sync_tombstones"."member_id" is not null)
